name: SATQuest
description: SATQuest is a verifier-based benchmark that generates diverse SAT-based logical reasoning tasks from CNF instances, enabling fine-grained, multi-dimensional evaluation and reinforcement fine-tuning of LLMs. It supports controlled, scalable, and reproducible analysis of logical reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A new verifier-based logical reasoning benchmark that is promising for controlled evaluation, but not yet widely established in the community.
notes: Uses PySAT for objective answer checking; includes randomized CNF generation to mitigate memorization; supports reinforcement fine-tuning.
